verdicts.title: On the p-adic Beilinson conjecture for number fields
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We formulate a conjectural p-adic analogue of Borel's theorem relating regulators for higher K-groups of number fields to special values of the corresponding zeta-functions, using syntomic regulators and p-adic L-functions. We also formulate a corresponding conjecture for Artin motives, and state a conjecture about the precise relation between the p-adic and classical situations. verdicts.title: p-adic Equiangular Lines and p-adic van Lint-Seidel Relative Bound
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce the notion of p-adic equiangular lines and derive the first fundamental relation between common angle, dimension of the space and the number of lines.
